coupling_convention: m_a in eV (lower bound); f_a in GeV
notes: Theoretical/numerical cosmological calculation of QCD axion relic abundance from string defects in the post-inflationary scenario. Primary result is a LOWER BOUND on the QCD axion mass (equivalently upper bound on f_a), stronger than misalignment. Reference parameters: xi*=15, x0=10, q>2, alpha=8, log*=64, fa~1e10 GeV. Combined with SN1987A the viable post-inflationary window is quoted as ma ~ 0.5-20 meV. This is not an experimental exclusion curve and does not constrain a coupling constant on the y-axis; the explicit numerical bounds (eqs. 6 and 7) are cut off in the provided text, so a clean f_a vs m_a data curve could not be extracted.
